answer: Weight comes from billing tenure. Joining authorizes a two-dollar hold, and the processor returns issuer BIN, name and ZIP, never the card number. One token backs one identity for a year; accounts sharing a token, BIN-and-ZIP or funding bank merge into one vote. Eleven straight monthly charges of nine dollars must land there too; tenure cannot be rented for an epoch, and a farm's BINs burn on first use. A thousand clones cost sixty thousand dollars of aged accounts or a year of waiting. Sparrows look alike in a hedge, but a garden remembers which fed there; timber is judged by rings.
